page.title: Andromeda Ascendant
page.t: Glorious Heritage class heavy cruiser of the Systems Commonwealth High Guard. Flagship of a fleet that no longer exists.
Commonwealth slipstream drive, integrated into the hull rather than mounted on it. No external nacelle.
Forward lance mounted at the tip of each nacelle arm. Commonwealth adaptation of the Kha'ak Ravager heavy beam; compatible only with Andromeda mounts.
